newsitem.title: ITALY: Three dead in Italian train crash.
newsitem.headline: Three dead in Italian train crash.

text.p: Three people were killed and 16 were injured on Monday when a single locomotive collided with a passenger train in northern Italy, civil protection officials said.
The two trains, run by the private Ferrovie Nord Milano company, collided head-on in late morning on the Brescia-Edolo line northeast of Milan.
Civil protection officials said a conductor and an engine driver died in the crash and another man died later in hospital. Six of the injured were in a serious condition.
Fire officials earlier put the death toll at four.
The accident occurred on a curved section of track near a level crossing in open country between two stations about 100 km (60 miles) from Milan.
A railway spokesman said the train coming from Brescia was a single locomotive while the other had two packed passenger carriages.
Road conditions are very bad in many parts of Italy which has been paralysed by cold weather and heavy snowfalls.
Italian television said the cause of the crash was not yet known but frozen points was mentioned as a possible factor.
